messages:
Yara (People Ops): Heads-up — pasted below is a pragmatic first-week playbook for new team leads. Copy into the hire folder and tweak for your team. Short, prioritized, and focused on removing blockers. :seedling:

Mina (Team Lead): This is perfect. Can we call out who approves analytics & billing access? Last time it was slow.

Ibrahim (Hiring Lead): Approvals are manager-signed in Access Portal. If you flag 'urgent' and mention the hiring lead, IT will expedite.

Yara (People Ops): Playbook (recommendation, not strict):
- Pre-day (48–72h before start):
  - Confirm laptop, monitor, and peripherals. Confirm shipping ETA with IT.
  - Add recurring 1:1 + 30/60/90 review slots to calendar (placeholders).
  - Drop welcome note to team with 3 bullet points about the hire.
- Day 1 (People + context):
  - 09:00 Team intro (25m) — round-robin intros, 3 things the team is shipping this quarter.
  - 10:00 Role expectations w/ hiring lead (20m) — decisions they can make vs escalate.
  - 14:00 Stakeholder corridor (quick intros): PM, Platform, SRE (10–15m each).
- Day 2 (Access + safety):
  - IT handoff: Okta/SSO, Slack, email, VPN, analytics read, billing read. Mark analytics/billing as high priority.
  - Security: data handling attestation & devbox baseline (10–15m).
  - Request GitHub org membership and repo access.
- Day 3 (First ship + ops):
  - Pick a small doc/bug/README improvement to own and close (early visible win).
  - Draft 30/60/90 and share with hiring lead for feedback.
- By end of week:
  - Finalize 30/60/90, publish to manager & people ops, and schedule a 30-day quick sync.

Mina (Team Lead): For the small ship, any examples?

Yara (People Ops): Examples: update an onboarding README, fix a flaky test, add a dashboard note, or ship a tiny config tweak that improves dev ergonomics. Goal = visible momentum.

Riley (IT): To speed provisioning: DM me corp email + paste SSH pub key. Approvals needed for analytics/billing: tag your hiring lead in the Access Portal request. Quick SSH steps:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "first.last@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Paste pub key into Access Portal -> Tech Access. I'll attach standard groups once approval appears. :computer:

Samira (Security): Note: do not pull production datasets until the data handling attestation is signed. Link in handbook -> Security. If you need sandboxed datasets for the first week, request via #dataops.

Ibrahim (Hiring Lead): We recommend weekly 1:1s for the first 12 weeks and a skip-level check at ~30 days (10–15m). Also add a biweekly team retro starting in week 2.

Mina (Team Lead): Sending access requests now. Also planning to give clear autonomy boundaries in our week-1 chat.

Yara (People Ops): Who to ping if blocked: #help-it for provisioning (include "new-lead" and corp email), #security for attestations, @Yara for templates or if you want me to copy the 30/60/90 into your hire folder. Templates (SSO): onboarding templates repo.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: Submit payroll + tax forms (due in 48h).

Mina (Team Lead): Thanks all — copying this into the hire folder and sharing the 30/60/90 draft with Ibrahim later today.
